title: Concentration of the mass measure transfers across a difference supported in a closed set
statement: Let P, j ∈ ℕ, let S₁, S₂ ∈ 𝒟_j(ℝ^P) (GeometricCurrentOn univ j) be represented by integer multiplicity triples R₁ = (M₁, θ₁, ξ₁), R₂ = (M₂, θ₂, ξ₂) in ℝ^P (IMRep univ j with R₁.Represents S₁ and R₂.Represents S₂), and let F ⊆ ℝ^P be closed. Write μ_i := R_i.measure = θ_i·H^j⌞M_i (H^j = μHE[j]). Assume μ₂(ℝ^P ∖ F) = 0 and spt(S₁ − S₂) ⊆ F, where S₁ − S₂ is the contract difference ((S₁ − S₂)(ω) = S₁(ω) − S₂(ω)) and spt is the SimonGMT support (ℝ^P minus the union of the open sets with compact closure on which the current vanishes). Then μ₁(ℝ^P ∖ F) = 0.
lean_statement: ∀ (P j : ℕ) (S₁ S₂ : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) j) (R₁ R₂ : IMRep (univ : Set (Euclid P)) j) (F : Set (Euclid P)), R₁.Represents S₁ → R₂.Represents S₂ → IsClosed F → R₂.measure Fᶜ = 0 → (S₁ - S₂).support ⊆ F → R₁.measure Fᶜ = 0
